mechanism: Nifedipine may enhance anticholinergic effects of scopolamine through additive pharmacodynamic effects on cardiac conduction and CNS depression, while scopolamine may increase nifedipine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and mental status closely; consider alternative anticholinergic agent if possible; adjust nifedipine dose if needed based on clinical response.
